Sandbox_LTPMS_ThresholdOne_tooltip:
How low any tire needs to be for the light to turn on.
default is 0.9
Sandbox_LTPMS_ThresholdTwo_tooltip:
How low any tire needs to be for the light to start blinking.
default is 0.5
Sandbox_LTPMS_Ubiquity_tooltip: What vehicles TPMS sensors will be present on.
Sandbox_LTPMS_Whitelist_tooltip:
A string of semicolon-separated vehicles to allow TPMS to exist in.
Only used if Ubiquity is set to Custom.
For example:
Base.CarLuxury;Base.ModernCar;Base.ModernCar02;Base.ModernCar_Martin;
